$/version = "1.5.0"
$/prs = ["412", "398", "405"]

root = Panel([Stack([version, status], direction="horizontal", align="end", justify="between"), prs, npm, notes, actions], title="Release plan", description="Live. Edit it here or tell me what to change.")
